'''Marxa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an [[Imperial Agent|agent]] in the employ of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed at the Intelligence center aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Marxa appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a trainer for the Imperial Agent class on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
